about: The presets SHIPPED with the Effects Lab. This file travels with the code and an update overwrites it. The operator's own file is presets_config.json: a preset there with the same name wins over the factory one, so operator edits survive every update, and deleting an edited copy of a shipped preset returns it to this file's version.

decay.label: Decay
decay.hint: what survives each step; lower dies faster

rotate.label: Colour drift with age
rotate.hint: the channels rotate as the light ages; the show turns that into hue. 0 none

effuse.label: Effusion from the edge
effuse.hint: how far the light is pushed out from the body's edge per step

effuse_reach.label: Effusion reach
effuse_reach.hint: how far from the edge the push is felt, screen heights

emit.label: Emission from the joints
emit.hint: how far the light is pushed out from each joint per step

emit_reach.label: Joint tightness
emit_reach.hint: bigger = felt closer to the joint only

churn.label: Churn
churn.hint: the swirl that carries the light; 0 none

churn_size.label: Churn cells
churn_size.hint: cells per screen height; bigger = smaller cells

churn_speed.label: Churn evolution
churn_speed.hint: how fast the cells change shape

boil.label: Boil on the surface
boil.hint: light born on the body in cells that come and go, a different pattern per colour; 0 none

marble.label: Marbling
marble.hint: each colour carried along the light's own gradient, pixels; 0 = a smooth glow

reach.label: Reach from the body
reach.hint: how far from the body the light lives, screen heights

fade.label: Fade beyond reach
fade.hint: per step at and beyond reach; lower dies faster

hue_rate.label: Hue cycle with time
hue_rate.hint: 0.008 = one cycle every two minutes; 0 still

hue_age.label: Hue from age
hue_age.hint: how far the light's age moves the hue

inject.label: Picture painted in
inject.hint: the person's own video mixed into the light inside the mask; 0 = pure coloured light

seed_gain.label: The seeds on top
seed_gain.hint: the outline, hands and discs, sharper than what they became

inject.label: Picture painted in
inject.hint: how strongly the live cutout replaces the flowing copy inside the body each step; low = long dreamy smears, high = crisp body with short flames

boil.label: Boil in the body
boil.hint: the video's own pixels roil in place inside the mask: the fresh picture is taken through a swirling lens; 0 = a still picture

decay.label: Decay
decay.hint: what survives each step; lower dies faster

effuse.label: Effusion from the edge
effuse.hint: how far the picture is pushed out from the body's edge per step

effuse_reach.label: Effusion reach
effuse_reach.hint: how far from the edge the push is felt, screen heights

emit_reach.label: Joint tightness
emit_reach.hint: bigger = felt closer to the joint only

churn.label: Churn
churn.hint: the swirl that carries the picture; 0 none

churn_size.label: Churn cells
churn_size.hint: cells per screen height; bigger = smaller cells

churn_speed.label: Churn evolution
churn_speed.hint: how fast the swirl changes shape

marble.label: Marbling
marble.hint: each colour carried along the picture's own edges; 0 = a smooth smear

reach.label: Reach from the body
reach.hint: how far from the body the picture lives, screen heights

fade.label: Fade beyond reach
fade.hint: per step at and beyond reach; lower dies faster

rotate.label: Colour drift with age
rotate.hint: 0 keeps the video's own colours; higher shifts the hue as the light ages

punch.label: Colour punch
punch.hint: 1 = the video as it is, higher = richer, 0 = grey

outlines.about: A series of takes: every few seconds the person, outline and all, is snapshotted out of the video into its own layer. Takes age, dissolve to nothing and are deleted (the engine's history ring in cutout mode); nothing accumulates, so nothing smudges. The live picture can be dialled to black behind them.

backing.label: Live background
backing.hint: 1 = the full live picture behind everything, 0 = black; the person and the takes remain

takes.label: Takes opacity
takes.hint: how solidly the takes sit over the background

take_every.label: Seconds between takes
take_every.hint: a new take this often; six are kept, the oldest is deleted

take_count.label: Takes kept
take_count.hint: its own layer each; one falls off the end as a new one arrives

life.label: Take life (seconds)
life.hint: how long a take lives; it fades and dissolves continuously over this time, as fast as you like

dissolve.label: Dissolve
dissolve.hint: 0 = takes fade evenly, 1 = they are eaten away in a ragged pattern as they age

grain.label: Dissolve grain
grain.hint: size of the eaten pattern; bigger = finer

tint.label: Tint the takes
tint.hint: 0 = the takes keep the video's colours, 1 = fully coloured by the hue

live_solid.label: The person now
live_solid.hint: how solid the live person stands over the takes

glow.label: Outline glow
glow.hint: the edge trail from the outline seeds (the feedback frame)

fade.label: Outline trail length
fade.hint: how much of the edge trail survives each step

outlines.feed:
// the feedback frame carries only the outline seeds (drawn in by the Stage); they fade into a trail
ret = frame(uv) * fade;
